name: MoveWorkItem
label: Move Work Item
description: Moves a work item from one queue to another.

fields.name: WorkItemId
fields.label: WorkItem ID
fields.description: Enter the unique identifier of the work item you want to move.

fields.name: QueueId
fields.label: Select Queue
fields.description: Choose the destination queue where the work item will be moved.

fields.name: WorkItemData
fields.label: Work Item Data
fields.description: Provide the data payload for the work item in JSON format. This data will be stored with the work item.

fields.name: WorkItemRemark
fields.label: Remark
fields.description: Enter the remark for the work item.

fields.name: MovedWorkItem
fields.label: MovedWorkItem
fields.description: Returns true if work item moved successfully.
